name: mathema-app
description: Mathēma — AI-powered NCERT math learning app (Indian PoC, Class 7-12). Monorepo: server (NestJS) + app (React/Vite/Capacitor).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,app,solve -c green,cyan,magenta "npm -w server run start:dev" "npm -w app run dev" "npm run dev:math-helper"
scripts.dev:local: npm run db:up && npm run dev
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -n server,app -c green,cyan "npm -w server run start:dev" "npm -w app run dev"
scripts.android:list: npm -w app exec cap run android -- --list
scripts.build: npm -w server run build && npm -w app run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w server run typecheck && npm -w app exec tsc -- --noEmit
scripts.lint: npm -w server run lint && npm -w app run lint
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.db:migrate: npm run sync:env && npm -w server exec -- prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: npm run sync:env && npm -w server exec -- prisma db seed
scripts.db:studio: npm run sync:env && npm -w server exec -- prisma studio
